claims.claim: On 2026-10-14, arXiv carried MAI-Gym, an open platform unifying GUI agent evaluation, data collection and online RL training across mobile, computer and web environments.
claims.supporting_span: Published 2026-10-14 by arXiv. Online reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has driven rapid progress in mathematics, coding, and tool use, but scaling this success to GUI agents remains challenging due to the high cost of interactive environments and the scarcity of realistic training tasks. We introduce MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments.
